name: svelte-effect-runtime-vscode
description: VS Code extension that installs and launches the SER LSP from npm.

Svelte Effect Runtime: Stop Language Server

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.ena.description: Start the npm-installed Svelte Effect Runtime language server automatically for Svelte files.

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.cli.description: Language-client strategy. Auto uses the official Svelte extension client when installed to avoid duplicate Svelte language servers, otherwise it starts the bundled VS Code client directly.

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.pat.description: Absolute path to a custom svelte-effect-runtime-language-server script. Leave empty to install the server from npm.
